form.name: Policy name
form.platformFeeHint: Paid by the renter on both tracks. Each vehicle type is charged once per trip, or multiplied by the rental days (every rental type, long-term included).
form.commissionHint: Deducted from the owner's payout. Each rental day uses the % of the tier it falls in.
form.previewTitle: Example: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} × {daily}
form.previewInvalid: Fix the tiers to see an example.
form.depositHint: Reservation payment = platform fee + insurance + prepaid rental. Prepaid rental defaults to 30% of the rental (excluding the delivery fee) and already includes the platform commission - commission is not added on top. The owner's real share of it is 30% of the rental - commission; the guest pays the owner the remaining 70% of the rental plus the delivery fee at pickup. On a late cancellation or no-show the owner receives all of their real share.
form.depositPercent: Prepaid rental (% of rental, commission included)
form.holdPaymentWindowHint: Each trip gets its own transfer deadline: 30% of the time from approval to pickup, at least 15 minutes, at most this value, and never past pickup.
form.freeCancelHint: The free cancellation window only starts once the hold is fully paid: 20% of the time from payment to pickup, at least 15 minutes, at most this value, and never past pickup.
form.taxEnabled: Withhold and remit tax on behalf of owners
form.taxEnabledHint: Under Decree 117/2025/ND-CP the platform withholds and remits VAT and PIT for household and individual sellers. Turn on only once a tax adviser has confirmed the classification. Tax is computed on the rental amount, excluding the delivery fee; each tax is exact to the dong.

validation.limitOrder: The maximum must be greater than the minimum
validation.suggestedInRange: The suggested rate must be within the wage-per-day range

form.taxLegalBasisHint: The legal reference for the withholding - shown to owners and printed on the tax ledger.
form.taxScope: Applies to: individuals, household businesses · Companies: not withheld
form.taxScopeValue: Individuals, household businesses · Verified companies: not withheld
form.withDriverLimitsHint: Blocks unreasonable numbers (a missing or extra zero) - not price control. Applies to a vehicle's with-driver daily price and the driver wage per day shops record.
form.driverWageSuggestedHint: Only a market reminder for shops that haven't set a rate - never written into a shop or a trip.
form.bookingLimitsHint: Applies to renters' booking requests on the marketplace. Self-drive trips longer than the maximum must be booked as long-term rentals. Long-term rentals are not limited here.
form.maxAdvanceBookingDays: Book ahead at most (self-drive, with driver)
form.intro: The policy in effect is never edited in place: changes are saved as a new version. Save a draft to review later, or Save and apply so quotes and approvals use the new numbers from now on. Existing bookings keep their numbers.
